title: LoopVL: Recurrent Visual Intelligence
abstract: We introduce LoopVL to study whether Loop Transformers can be effectively extended to vision- language models. LoopVL combines Module-Loop and Model-Loop computation to iteratively update a unified vision-language state through shared modules. We train LoopVL from scratch through language pre-training, multimodal training, and post-training. LoopVL outperforms a range of similarly sized and larger non-recurrent models on multimodal understanding and visual reasoning benchmarks. We also observe Visual Aha Moments in LoopVL, characterized by pronounced shifts in visual attention across loops. LoopVL provides practical evidence for recurrent vision-language modeling and offers an intuitive perspective on how shared parameters can support deeper multimodal computation over continuously evolving visual-language states.

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: In our hypothetical course, Transformer Architectures for Multimodal Reasoning, today's lecture is on Loop V-L: Recurrent Visual Intelligence. Recent work such as Qwen two V-L has advanced visual perception across resolutions, while Open V-L Thinker explores iterative training for complex reasoning. Loop V-L asks a different question: can a vision-language model improve by repeatedly reusing the same computation? Researchers from Renmin University of China and Shanghai Jiao Tong University investigate that possibility. I see a hand—yes, Noah?
segments.zh: 在我们这门假想的课程“面向多模态推理的Transformer架构”里，今天的讲座讲的是Loop V-L：循环视觉智能。最近的一些工作，比如Qwen two V-L，推进了跨分辨率的视觉感知，而Open V-L Thinker则探索了面向复杂推理的迭代训练。Loop V-L问的是一个不同的问题：一个视觉语言模型能不能通过反复复用同一套计算来提升自己？来自中国人民大学和上海交通大学的研究者研究了这种可能性。我看到有人举手——请讲，Noah？

segments.speaker: Noah
segments.en: Hi Professor, when you say recurrent, does the model repeat the same layers rather than add new ones?
segments.zh: 教授您好，您说的循环，是指模型重复使用同样的层，而不是增加新的层吗？

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: Exactly. A recurrent Transformer applies shared parameters multiple times, separating the number of stored layers from the depth of computation actually performed. That distinction matters as models grow: repeated processing may offer additional computation without storing a separate layer for every step. Loop V-L extends this idea to vision and language together. Instead of treating image features as fixed inputs, it asks whether visual representations should evolve as the model reasons.
segments.zh: 没错。循环Transformer会把共享参数反复用多次，从而把存储的层数和实际执行的计算深度分开。这个区别在模型变大时很关键：重复处理可以带来额外计算量，却不必为每一步都单独存一层。Loop V-L把这一思路扩展到了视觉和语言。它不再把图像特征当成固定输入，而是要问：随着模型进行推理，视觉表示是否也应该不断演化。

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: The paper builds on a hierarchical recurrence framework, not an entirely new architecture. It has an L module for repeated lower-level updates and an H module for higher-level integration. The authors examine not only benchmark scores but also how attention moves across spatially located image patches. Since those patches correspond to image regions, changing attention can be mapped back to the picture and inspected across repeated computation.
segments.zh: 这篇论文建立在分层循环框架之上，并不是一个全新的架构。它有一个L模块负责重复的低层更新，还有一个H模块负责更高层的整合。作者不仅考察基准分数，还研究了注意力如何在空间上分布的图像块之间移动。由于这些图像块对应图像区域，注意力的变化可以映射回原图，并在重复计算过程中加以观察。

segments.speaker: Noah
segments.en: Quick question: are the visual features recalculated from the image at every loop?
segments.zh: 问个快问题：每一轮循环都会从图像重新计算视觉特征吗？

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: Not from the image encoder. Loop V-L freezes its Penguin Vision Encoder, which produces features for image patches. A trainable projector maps those features into the language model's representation space. Then the projected visual tokens and the text are processed together. The key distinction is that the encoder's original features stay fixed, while the projected visual representations inside the recurrent backbone can change from one call to the next.
segments.zh: 不是从图像编码器来的。Loop V-L 冻结了它的 Penguin Vision Encoder，由它生成图像块的特征。一个可训练投影器把这些特征映射到语言模型的表示空间。然后，投影后的视觉 token 和文本一起处理。关键区别在于，编码器的原始特征保持不变，而循环主干内部投影后的视觉表示会在每次调用之间发生变化。

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: The default schedule is H-two-L-three: three L calls followed by one H call, repeated for two cycles. The L and H stacks each contain 16 Transformer layers, and each stack reuses its own parameters. Across the forward pass, this schedule makes 128 layer calls. At the start of the second cycle, the model also reintroduces an anchor based on the initial visual features, with a learned gate controlling its influence.
segments.zh: 默认的调度方式是H二L三：先做三次L调用，再做一次H调用，这样重复两个循环。L栈和H栈各自包含16层Transformer，并且每个栈都复用自己那套参数。整个前向传播下来，这个调度一共做了128次层调用。进入第二个循环时，模型还会重新引入一个基于初始视觉特征的锚点，并用一个学习出来的门控来控制它的影响。

segments.speaker: Noah
segments.en: Can you clarify why the model needs both the anchor and the gate?
segments.zh: 你能解释一下，为什么模型既需要锚点又需要门控吗？

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: The anchor provides a route back to the initial projected visual evidence, rather than allowing recurrent updates to drift without reference. The gate lets the model control how much of that information returns, conditioned on the query. In tests, attention shifts remain when the authors remove this mechanism, so the observed changes are not simply a direct effect of the anchor. Still, that ablation does not prove what causes the model to select any particular region.
segments.zh: 锚点提供了一条回到最初投影视觉证据的路径，而不是让循环更新在没有参照的情况下漂移。门控则让模型根据查询来控制有多少信息回流。在测试中，当作者移除这一机制后，注意力的变化依然存在，所以观察到的变化并不只是锚点带来的直接效果。不过，这个消融实验并不能证明是什么导致模型选择某个特定区域。

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: Training proceeds in stages: language-model pretraining, visual-language alignment, multimodal mid-training, supervised fine-tuning, and a final reinforcement-learning stage using G-R-P-O. During alignment, the backbone and image encoder are frozen while the projector is trained. Later stages update the backbone and projector, keeping the image encoder frozen. The default also uses selective backpropagation: all recurrent calls run forward, but gradients pass through a subset of later calls during training.
segments.zh: 训练分几个阶段进行：先是语言模型预训练，然后是视觉-语言对齐，接着是多模态中期训练、监督微调，最后是用GRPO做强化学习。在对齐阶段，主干网络和图像编码器冻结，只训练投影器。后续阶段会更新主干网络和投影器，图像编码器保持冻结。默认配置还用了选择性反向传播：所有循环调用都跑前向，但训练时梯度只穿过后面一部分调用。

segments.speaker: Noah
segments.en: Does adding more recurrent steps at inference reliably improve the results?
segments.zh: 推理时增加更多循环步骤，能稳定提升结果吗？

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: No. In inference tests, the schedule used during training performs best. Adding more L calls within the two H cycles can help, but adding H cycles beyond the training setup lowers scores. This is a useful implementation lesson: recurrence is not a free dial for improving performance. The model learns a particular pattern of state updates, and changing that pattern at test time can move it away from the computation it was trained to use.
segments.zh: 不能。在推理测试中，训练时使用的调度方案表现最好。在两个H循环内增加更多L调用可能有帮助，但超出训练设置增加H循环会降低分数。这是一个有用的实现经验：循环并不是一个可以随意调节来提升性能的旋钮。模型学到的是特定模式的状态更新，在测试时改变这一模式，可能会让它偏离训练时所使用的计算方式。

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: On the same training-token budget, Loop V-L beats the paper's 1-billion-parameter dense Transformer baseline on reported tasks. MMStar rises from 55.33 to 63.47, RealWorldQA from 55.29 to 70.98, and ChartQA from 51.12 to 74.52. The model is also competitive with larger dense baselines in estimated training computation. These comparisons suggest shared layers can support useful executed depth, though they do not establish lower latency or deployment cost.
segments.zh: 在相同的训练 token 预算下，Loop V-L 在论文报告的各个任务上都超过了 10 亿参数的稠密 Transformer 基线。MMStar 从 55.33 提升到 63.47，RealWorldQA 从 55.29 提升到 70.98，ChartQA 从 51.12 提升到 74.52。在估算的训练计算量方面，该模型也能与更大的稠密基线一较高下。这些对比表明，共享层可以支撑有效的执行深度，但并不能证明延迟更低或部署成本更小。

segments.speaker: Noah
segments.en: How strong is the evidence that attention shifts actually help the model answer correctly?
segments.zh: 注意力变化确实能帮模型答对的证据有多强？

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: That is an important limitation. In a diagnostic set of 32 examples, visual attention becomes more concentrated in the second cycle, with mean Gini concentration rising from 0.405 to 0.858 at the cycle boundary. Some patches initially ranked low become highly ranked later. But attention allocation is not causal evidence: these measurements do not show that the newly emphasized regions produce correct answers, and the selected examples cannot establish how often this happens.
segments.zh: 这是一个重要的局限。在一组包含32个样本的诊断集中，视觉注意力在第二个循环中变得更加集中，平均基尼集中度在循环边界处从0.405上升到0.858。一些最初排名较低的图像块后来排名变高。但注意力分配并不是因果证据：这些测量结果并不能表明新被强调的区域产生了正确答案，而且所选样本也无法确定这种情况发生的频率。

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: The authors call the shift a Visual Aha Moment, but the term describes an observable pattern, not a complete account of reasoning. Other probes show visual states continue to change, rather than merely copying their earlier values. Meanwhile, the intermediate answer distribution moves most sharply toward the final one during the last H computation, consistent with H integrating information late in the pass. Taken together, these findings offer diagnostic clues, not proof of a specific reasoning mechanism.
segments.zh: 作者把这个转变称为“视觉顿悟时刻”，但这个说法描述的是一种可观察到的模式，而不是对推理的完整解释。其他探测结果显示，视觉状态在持续变化，而不只是复制之前的取值。与此同时，中间答案分布在最后一次H计算时最急剧地转向最终答案，这与H在推理过程后期整合信息的情况一致。综合来看，这些发现提供的是诊断性线索，而不是对某种具体推理机制的证明。

segments.speaker: Noah
segments.en: How does this fit with iterative approaches like Open V-L Thinker, and what should researchers test next?
segments.zh: 这和Open V-L Thinker这类迭代方法有什么关系，研究人员接下来该测试什么？

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: Open V-L Thinker emphasizes iterative supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning, whereas Loop V-L focuses on recurrence inside a forward pass and the evolution of visual representations. Both reflect interest in iterative computation, but at different levels of the system. Loop V-L's findings encourage researchers to study not just how many steps a model takes, but how those steps are organized. Broader tests could examine other recurrence designs, video, multiple images, and causal interventions on attended regions.
segments.zh: Open V-L Thinker 强调的是迭代式的监督微调和强化学习，而 Loop V-L 关注的是单次前向传播内部的循环以及视觉表征的演化。两者都体现了对迭代计算的兴趣，但处于系统的不同层面。Loop V-L 的发现鼓励研究者不仅关注模型走了多少步，还要关注这些步骤是如何组织的。更广泛的测试可以考察其他循环设计、视频、多张图像，以及对被关注区域进行因果干预。

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: The central takeaway is that parameter sharing can produce changing multimodal computation when the shared layers repeatedly process an evolving state. Loop V-L provides evidence that schedule design matters and that visual attention can shift across cycles, while leaving open whether those shifts cause better reasoning or generalize beyond this setup. For PhD researchers, the next step is to connect internal dynamics to controlled outcomes. Thanks for listening. If you have any further questions, ask our AI assistant or drop a comment.
segments.zh: 核心结论是：当共享层反复处理一个不断演化的状态时，参数共享可以产生不断变化的多模态计算。Loop V-L 提供的证据表明，调度设计很重要，视觉注意力也会在不同循环之间发生转移，但它没有回答这些转移究竟是带来了更好的推理，还是能否推广到其他设定。对博士生研究者来说，下一步是把内部动态与可控的结果联系起来。感谢收听。如果还有任何问题，可以问我们的 AI 助手，或者留言评论。
